instructions: Cut the potatoes into 1/2 inch pieces. Cut the eggplant into 1 inch pieces and the zucchini into 1/2 inch half-moons. Chop the peppers and onion, and slice the garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a Dutch oven or wide pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic and stir for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, eggplant and 1/2 tsp of the salt. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring often.
Add the zucchini, peppers and the canned tomatoes with their juice. Stir, bring to a simmer, then cover and cook on medium-low for 12 minutes, until the potatoes are tender. Stir now and then.
Chop 1/6 cup each of basil and parsley.
Take the lid off. Stir in the herbs, the remaining 1/2 tsp salt and the black pepper. Cook for 5 minutes, until the sauce thickens a little.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt.
method_notes: Running to the Kitchen (4.79 from 65) leads: onion and garlic softened in olive oil, then potatoes, eggplant, zucchini, peppers and tomato simmered covered, finished with basil and parsley. Spinach Tiger uses canned tomatoes and a 1 hour simmer; this version uses a 28 oz can in place of 5 fresh plum tomatoes so it has sauce and fits the time, and cuts the vegetables smaller. Amounts are scaled from 6 servings to 4.
